newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Santander downgrades two Colombian banks.
newsitem.headline: Santander downgrades two Colombian banks.

text.p: Santander Investment said it was downgrading its rating on two Colombian banks, Banco Ganadero and Banco de Bogota.

It said Banco de Bogota, the country's fourth-largest bank in terms of assets, was cut from market perform to underperform while Ganadero, Colombia's largest commercial bank, was downgraded from buy to market perform.
Santander said it maintained its buy ratings on Banco Industrial Colombiano (BIC) and Banco de Colombia, however.
It said BIC was the only major bank not to substantially increase provision expenses in the fourth quarter, thanks largely to "its adequate coverage level and excellent asset quality."
Of Banco de Bogota, it said it was cutting its 12-month target price from $7 to $6.55 per share and added that Banco Ganadero's preferred ADRs were seen slipping from $24 to $22.50
